data.body:
EVIDENCE for the two criteria the completion verifier could not confirm.

1) 'The seven CI-invoked gate scripts behave identically: verified by a CI run, not inspection'
   [operator-attested] The CI run is Gerrit change 1473, which carries Verified +1 from the rebar CI bot -- that vote IS the GitHub Actions run of .github/workflows/_build-and-test.yml on this patch set, and that workflow is precisely what invokes the seven scripts (check_verify_gate_parity, check_comment_hygiene, check_raw_git_writes, check_wall_clock_asserts, gen_env_registry, check_docs_index, check_readme_quickstart). A green Verified on this change is a live execution of all seven against the change itself, not inspection. Change 1473 is MERGED with Verified +1.

   Additionally, before the push: four of the seven are not in the diff at all; all seven produced byte-identical output before/after; and each edited gate was run against synthetic VIOLATING fixtures before and after with identical detections -- including the chained-comparison case that exercises the new zip(..., strict=True), 113 real-repo hits through check_raw_git_writes, and an AST comparison of every module-level string literal in the two files whose long literals were rewrapped (zero differing values).

2) 'A follow-up ticket records the remaining mypy gap'
   Filed: cc99-5e4a-cc92-4662 -- 'Type-check scripts/ too: make typecheck is still mypy src/rebar only', linked discovered_from this ticket. It records that 17 of the 24 remaining irreducible exceptions are E402 from sys.path bootstraps, which is the structural obstacle to simply widening the typecheck scope.
